title: lycaste skinneri subvar. alba
intro: Lycaste skinneri subvar. alba, commonly known as the White Lycaste Orchid, is a type of flowering orchid plant that belongs to the Lycaste genus. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Lycaste skinneri subvar. alba include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
